import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["RATE_FEED"].copy()

    # Preserve legacy cursor ordering: account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to mimic deterministic cursor fetch order
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account only (never crosses account boundaries)
    filled = df.groupby("account_id", sort=False)["rate"].ffill()

    was_null = df["rate"].isna()
    was_carried = (was_null & filled.notna()).astype("int64")

    result = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": df["account_id"],
        "obs_seq": df["obs_seq"],
        "obs_date": df["obs_date"],
        "rate_filled": filled,
        "was_carried": was_carried,
    })

    return {"rate_filled": result}
